title: Offline Learning Portal
description: A Windows school LAN resource portal using NGINX and NSSM, with configurable installation, a local resource catalogue, three illustrated user guides and uninstall options. Optional Kiwix integration is documented but is not bundled or newly Windows-tested. See included validation and third-party notices. Creator/contact: Tirtharaj Dhungana, tirtharajdhungana84@gmail.com. Includes 4-, 10- and 10-page novice manuals and complete original lesson examples.
